Favor Indonesia-exposed names over US peers; the +0.03% ID vs -0.39% US spread confirms domestic bid. Trim US laggards like CBOE/APO on relative weakness, and add on any dip to 5-day support.

sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: Indonesia's geothermal pipeline (PGEO, BRPT) benefits from state-mandated capacity targets and Baseload pricing, insulating it from global rate swings and making it a structural compounder.
Domestic solar demand is accelerating via rural electrification and industrial rooftop mandates, favoring local integrators (PKPK) over import-dependent US peers facing tariff and IRA uncertainty.
Climate-tech capital flows are bifurcating: US names (RUN, FSLR) trade on Fed policy, while ASEAN players gain from sovereign green funds and JETP disbursements, creating a persistent valuation gap.
sectors.ai: Buy selective Indonesian geothermal and solar names (PGEO, BRPT) on resilient domestic demand and tariff support; avoid US-exposed equipment makers (RUN, FSLR) where rate-cut repricing is fading. Position for Q3 earnings beats in IDX-listed utilities, and trim longs into any index-level bounce above 1% as global clean-energy sentiment stays fragile.

sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG
themes: Indonesia's resilient domestic consumption, driven by a young population and rising middle class, underpins sustained FMCG volume growth despite global headwinds.
Mid-cap consumer companies are outperforming large caps as they gain market share through localized distribution and digital commerce, a durable structural shift.
Input-cost deflation in commodities (palm oil, sugar) is expanding margins for food processors, creating a persistent earnings tailwind for agile operators.
sectors.ai: Buy selective mid-cap consumer names with proven earnings momentum (IATA, AGAR, ERTX) as domestic demand holds; avoid US-exposed laggards. Rotate into food/beverage and personal-care sub-sectors showing volume recovery, and trim names with weak balance sheets. Watch for Q2 earnings confirmations before adding leverage.

Position for Q3 capex announcements and Jokowi legacy projects; trim any position that breaks its 20-day moving average.
